_comment: Copy to sources.json and edit. The real file is gitignored — your target list is your business. Run `python3 resolve_sources.py` before trusting a board slug: an HTTP 200 is not proof you have the right employer.

sources._note: extra_location_ok whitelists location strings this one board uses that the profile cannot anticipate — a campus name, an internal site code. Better than widening the profile for everybody.
